project_name: Pollard Land Company proposed data center
aliases: Pollard Lumber Co. data center concept
developer: Pollard Land Company / Pollard Lumber Co. (landowner); data center developer not publicly identified
status_detail: McCormick County Planning Commission recommended denial of rezoning request tied to a proposed data center site and recommended a 9-month data center moratorium; county chair said no formal data center application/development proposal had been received as of late July 2026.
notes: Proposal involved rezoning about 1,000 acres off Whitetown Road around two miles from downtown McCormick; reporting also references a related proposed natural gas pipeline. Status reflects planning commission recommendation, not necessarily final County Council action.

aliases: Mid-Carolina Commerce Park II data center

status_detail: County statement said Project Altair would option remaining acreage in Mid-Carolina Commerce Park II to a developer intending to lease buildings to a data center tenant; Newberry County Council later unanimously denied the ordinance at third reading and then imposed a 12-month data center permit moratorium.
notes: Official county page says Santee Cooper was studying whether the local electrical grid could support the small-to-medium data center; news reports place the site at Mid-Carolina Commerce Park in Prosperity.

project_name: Valara Holdings High Performance Compute Center
status_detail: NorthMark/SC Governor announcement describes a $2.8B high-performance computing center at 4000 South Pine Street; SCDES says Valara is a data center in Spartanburg requiring environmental permits before operations and documents onsite generation with 24 generators plus proposed 11 turbines (five 17 MW and six 54 MW units). Local reporting says construction is underway and disruptive to nearby residents.
notes: Capacity_mw is inferred from the SCDES generation equipment described in the fact sheet: 5*17 MW + 6*54 MW = 409 MW proposed turbine capacity, excluding the separately referenced 24 generators whose MW total was not captured in snippet.
